snippet.description:
AIR 56 Samiksha Dwivedi shares how her Mains test-writing strategy evolved across her UPSC attempts. After writing around 60 tests in 2023, she reduced them in 2024, but realised that her performance suffered. In 2025, she returned to regular practice while also focusing on value addition and improving answer quality. Her experience highlights the importance of consistency and purposeful practice.
